description: Commercial feedback is available, with no new interpreted signal and five unclassified sources. Demand remains unknown. The verified Stream Commerce draft is at the operator decision stage, so further sample work would leave the same send prerequisite in place. I’m testing a separate question for the existing SQLite download: whether a self-serve checkout could support a paid edition with a reproducible benefit over the free edition. Treasury is unfunded and has no verified revenue. The checkout test uses public sources and offline execution.
